_comment: Declarative capability maturity map consumed by src/tools/status_artifact.py.
stage must be one of CAPABILITY_MATURITY_STAGES in src/config/constants.py, weakest first:
imports, tested, integrated, trains, benchmarked, gated.
'claims' lists the docs/CLAIM_LEDGER.md rows that support the stage. The generator refuses a
stage above the ceiling implied by the weakest supporting grade (CLAIM_GRADE_MATURITY_CEILING),
so a capability cannot advertise a stage its own ledger rows contradict. Raising a stage here
without first raising the grade of its claims is therefore a CI failure, not an edit.

capabilities.name: mcts-search-semantics
capabilities.notes: Ceiling is 'tested' while CL-1 is FALSE: three of four engines disagree on the value perspective. Milestone E2.

capabilities.name: graph-orchestration
capabilities.notes: Typed checkpointed graph with runtime introspection endpoints; no artefact records a served structure.

capabilities.name: domain-registry
capabilities.notes: One adapter contract across three games; not exercisable on a default install.

capabilities.name: self-play-training
capabilities.notes: Trainer paths unit-tested. Cannot claim 'trains' until a convergence artefact exists. Milestone E3.

capabilities.name: policy-lift-measurement
capabilities.notes: One committed smoke artefact on a synthetic domain with a gameable reward; no cost denominator. Milestone E4.

capabilities.name: system-benchmarking
capabilities.notes: Cost and latency are recorded but quality is never normalised by them. Milestone E4.

capabilities.name: checkpoint-promotion
capabilities.notes: No candidate-versus-champion gate exists; the arena in SelfPlayEvaluator has no caller. Milestone E5.

capabilities.name: spec-driven-development
capabilities.notes: Spec traceability and deterministic doc validation both run in CI and have rejected changes.

capabilities.name: operational-posture
capabilities.notes: Fail-loud default is correct and tested; no artefact from a running container.
